div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://qualityregistry.org/CodeSystem/stroke-risk-factor-cs defines the following code:

tr.td: The patient smoked at any time during the 10 years preceding the index stroke event.

title.value: RES-Q Stroke Risk Factor Code System

description.value: Locally governed RES-Q concepts used when the registry assertion is more specific than an available standard terminology concept.

purpose.value: To preserve registry-specific stroke risk-factor semantics without conflating them with broader or different SNOMED CT concepts.

definition.value: The patient smoked at any time during the 10 years preceding the index stroke event.
